title: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
description: Work with colleagues from different functions to plan tasks, share information, and complete work on time. Communicate progress, align priorities, and resolve routine coordination issues during team activities.
related_skills: work as part of a team
soft_skills_description: Needed to exchange information clearly, understand different team perspectives, and keep work aligned across functions.
rationale: The title captures the shared action across the strongest items: collaboration with and across cross-functional teams. The description turns that broad phrasing into observable behavior such as sharing information, aligning priorities, and completing tasks with others. A learner can demonstrate mastery by participating in a multi-role project and coordinating work without constant supervision. This competency stands apart by emphasizing general collaboration rather than the more specific dimension of working closely in day-to-day execution.
